title: NVS Class 6 Online Form 2027-28 – Date Extend
postName: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Selection Test (JNVST) 2027 – Class VI
vacancyDetails: Admission to Class 6 in JNVs for academic session 2027-28 (district-wise seats)
qualification: Studying in Class 5 in 2026-27 in a recognized school in the same district; age as per JNVST prospectus
ageLimit: As per JNVST 2027 age criteria (born within dates in notification)
selectionProcess: JNVST Entrance Test → Merit / District-wise selection
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, photo ID, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://navodaya.gov.in or https://cbseitms.rcil.gov.in/nvs/
2. Open Class VI JNVST 2027 registration
3. Fill student and parent details
4. Upload photo and documents
5. Submit free form by 31 July 2026
shortDescription: NVS Class 6 Online Form 2027-28 (JNVST 2027) – apply free 7–31 July 2026. Exam 28 Nov 2026 for summer-bound JNVs.
content:
Navodaya Vidyalaya Samiti has opened online applications for Class VI admission 2027–28 through JNVST 2027.

Apply: 7 July 2026 to 31 July 2026 (no fee). Summer-bound exam date: 28 November 2026.

Portals: navodaya.gov.in / cbseitms.rcil.gov.in/nvs.
